Requirement chrome-attuned

Duration constant

Even hollowed out, the frame keeps more of you running than it should.

While at Hollowed Drift, treat your Weakness to electricity and to disrupt-construct/technomancy effects as Weakness 2 instead of 5, and Treat Wounds heals you normally rather than for half.
